github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Follow the Conventional Commits specification. The commit message must start with one of the types build, chore, ci, docs, feat, fix, perf, refactor, revert, style or test (commitlint config-conventional), optionally followed by a scope in parentheses. Append ! before the colon to denote a breaking change. Format: <type>(<optional scope>)[optional !]: <short description>. Use the imperative mood, lowercase, no trailing period.

github.copilot.chat.pullRequestDescripti.text: The PR title must follow the Conventional Commits specification using one of the types build, chore, ci, docs, feat, fix, perf, refactor, revert, style or test (commitlint config-conventional), optionally followed by a scope in parentheses. Append ! before the colon to denote a breaking change. Format: <type>(<optional scope>)[optional !]: <short description>. Use the imperative mood, lowercase, no trailing period. The required check conventions / title (organisation's shared workflow) enforces it.
